newsitem.title: CANADA: TrizecHahn to sell C$250 mln of debentures.
newsitem.headline: TrizecHahn to sell C$250 mln of debentures.

text.p: TrizecHahn Corp on Wednesday said it filed a preliminary prospectus with provincial securities regulators to sell C$250 million of unsecured debentures.
The Toronto-based real estate company, Canada's largest, said the proceeds of the offering will be used primarily to reduce indebtedness.
TrizecHahn said it intends to issue an aggregate principal amount of C$125 million of seven-year debentures and an aggregate principal amount of C$125 million of ten-year debentures.

The debentures have been rated B++ by Canadian Bond Rating Service with a positive rating outlook and BBB by Dominion Bond Rating Service, TrizecHahn said. The offering will be issued through a group of underwriters comprised of Goldman Sachs Canada, Nesbitt Burns Inc and Midland Walwyn Capital Inc.
TrizecHahn said the debentures have not been registered under U.S. securities lawas and will not be offered there except under special circumstances.

TrizecHahn last month scaled back a proposed equity offering of 12.5 million shares when its share price slumped following the announcement. The equity issue was reduced to 7.5 million shares and was expected to generate gross proceeds of US$150 million for the company.

Since it was formed by a merger of Horsham Corp and Trizec Corp Ltd last year, TrizecHahn has pursued a strategy of aggressively acquiring U.S. office buildings and reducing their vacancy rates. The company is now one of North America's largest publicly traded real estate firms, with interests in 69 income-producing properties.
TrizecHahn will hold its first annual meeting in its new form in Toronto on Thursday at Royal York Hotel Ballroom, 100 Front Street West at 1100 EST/1500 GMT.

TrizecHahn shares were down C$0.70 to C$29.75 in late afternoon trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange. More than 21,000 shares had changed hands. TrizecHahn is listed in Toronto, Montreal and New York.
